profile.headline: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A technology-driven and result-oriented professional with a proven track record for embedded systems software development for the Medical, Telematics, Consumer, and Industrial IoT domain. 

• Experienced team lead (for a team of 8 engineers)
• Experience in requirement gathering, analysis of requirement specification, development as well as QA activities, 
• Good hands-on FCC and PTCRB certification process
• Experience of both Agile and Waterfall methodology for software development
• Experience in On-site Coordination and working as a Liaison
• 3+ years of experience in the US telematics industry 
• 2 years of experience for QA of medical devices (FDA compliance)
• 6 years of experience for IoT based products development
• Excellent troubleshooter for bare metal, Freertos, and Linux application space code (Good hands-on use gdb, debugger supported by IAR, stm32cube IDE etc)
• Good hands-on Linux kernel, Device drivers

Expertise:
• Bare-Metal, FreeRTOS, Embedded Linux, Linux Yocto build system
• Designing mission-critical embedded healthcare products and control systems
• Test automation
• CAN, J1939, MODBUS-RTU Protocol
• ZigBee, Thread, LoRAWAN technologies
• Debugging using GDB and JTAG debugger

positions.title: Design Engineer

Developed firmware for Dimension Measurement machine,  PAL video superimposer, Ticket Machine, Energy meter, Control system of Split AC, Stepper Motor Driver for CNC machine etc.

Developed Driver library for peripherals of ARM7 based LPC2148.

Worked on ARM cortex-M3 based Luminary Microcontrollers ,ARM7 based LPC2148 controllers & also got exposure to hardware debugging of Micro-controller.

projects.title: Smart Vehicle Platform
projects.description:
This product is mostly targeted for the semitrailer to make them smart and resolve many problems for safety and prevent major maintenance by actively notifying the fleet about potential problems related to vehicle's mechanical and safety related issues as well as DOT compliance issues.

It provides asset tracking, cargo safety, cargo estimation,  vehicle safety, tire pressure control system, brake system monitoring, Vehicle to vehicle communication, reports vehicle utilization. Apart from that the gateway had different interfaces to communicate with vehicle J1939 CAN network as well as PLC network to communicate with ABS, ECU etc. It has different wired and wireless interfaces for future expandability. 

My contribution:
● Firmware tech lead and liaison between customer and my team
● Contributed from concept to certification phase for the product
● R&D for different confidential algorithms for leak detection, predictive maintenance of Brake system and tires and tire pressure control system
● Validation of product in the field on actual semi-trailer

projects.title: Diagnostic Application for Embedded Board
projects.description:
- Diagnosis of embedded hardware is necessary as a part of quality assurance for any company. 
- Diagnostic application is mainly designed for diagnosis of on board available peripherals to MCU  like SPI, Flash, RAM, PCI, I2C etc.

MyRole: I have developed test suite for I2C bus on Panda board, PCI Host & Ethernet Switch of  AP96 & AP91 Board.
